Government Releases Names of Six Personnel Killed in Operation Sindoor

The Indian government has publicly released the names of six armed forces personnel who were killed during 'Operation Sindoor'. This marks the first time these names have been made public. Among the six personnel, five belonged to the army and one to the air force. Some reports indicate that these names will be honored at the National War Memorial.
